'''August 2001 Salt Lake City tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Mind Games, Salt Lake City, Utah in August 2001. Nathan won it. It is known from Cortney Haggerty's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2853">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-mind-games-aka-k-now-god2853/ mind-games-aka-k-now-go], DeckTech (Cortney "dope5tar" Haggerty, 16 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-mind-games-aka-k-now-god2853/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' August 2001
* '''Site:''' Mind Games, Salt Lake City, Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' Nathan
